docs.title: Shang-Chieh Wang
docs.text:
Incoming M.Ed. Student in Brain Science · NYCU | B.Ed. in Kinesiology · NTHU

Institute of Education, Major in Brain Science, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, Taiwan

I'm a graduate student in Brain Science at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, Taiwan — bridging a background in kinesiology with cognitive neuroscience and statistical neuroimaging to understand how the brain ages, and how movement can protect it.

Email: scwang1005@gmail.com GitHub: github.com/chieh1005

docs.title: Research Focus
docs.text:
My work sits at the intersection of clinical neuroscience and human movement — using brain imaging to probe the mechanisms of neurodegenerative disease.

  • Cognitive Neuroscience — How attention, memory, and executive function reshape themselves across the lifespan.
  • Neuroimaging · fMRI & EEG — fMRI & EEG pipelines to map brain structure, function, and connectivity.
  • Exercise, Psychology & Aging — Whether physical activity can slow cognitive decline and neurodegeneration.

docs.title: Education
docs.text:
I hold a Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) in Kinesiology from National Tsing Hua University (NTHU), where I developed a strong foundation in human movement science and exercise physiology.

Currently, I am an incoming Master of Education (M.Ed.) student in Brain Science at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU), where I'll pursue advanced studies in cognitive neuroscience and neuroimaging.

docs.title: Research Interests
docs.text: My academic journey has taken me from the study of human movement and kinesiology to the investigation of brain mechanisms underlying age-related cognitive decline. I am particularly interested in:

docs.title: Cognitive Neuroscience
docs.text: Understanding how attention, memory, and executive function change across the lifespan, and how these changes relate to neurobiological mechanisms.

docs.title: Neuroimaging Methods
docs.text: Developing and applying advanced fMRI and EEG analysis pipelines to map brain structure, function, and connectivity in both healthy and clinical populations.

docs.title: Exercise Neuroscience
docs.text: Investigating whether and how physical activity can serve as a protective factor against cognitive decline and neurodegenerative disease.

docs.title: Curriculum Vitae
docs.text:
Shang-Chieh Wang — Graduate Student Email: scwang1005@gmail.com · Location: Taiwan

Graduate Student in Brain Science at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, with a strong foundation in Kinesiology from National Tsing Hua University. Specialized in cognitive neuroscience, utilizing fMRI and EEG to investigate how physical activity and resistance exercise influence cognitive functions and emotional regulation in aging populations.

Bachelor of Education, Kinesiology (Graduated with distinction) National Tsing Hua University, Taiwan

  • Research Project: Investigate the effects of low intensity resistance exercise combined with slow movement and tonic force generation on executive function in older adults.

docs.title: Experience
docs.text:
2024 – 2026

Undergraduate Researcher National Tsing Hua University, Taiwan

Conducted multiple research projects focusing on how physical activity may influence brain function in special populations in order to develop personalized exercise prescriptions for them.

  • The Effect of Low-intensity Resistance Exercise with Slow Movement and Tonic Force Generation on Cognitive Flexibility in Older Adults (NSTC Project): Designed methodology, executed standardized experiments (n=45), and analyzed data.
  • Effects of Volume-Matched Acute Exercise on Metacognition in Late Middle-Aged Adults: Administered experiments, analyzed data, and drafted journal articles.
  • Investigating the Relationship Between Physical Activity and Executive Function in Adolescents with Hearing Impairments: Designed methodology, executed experiments, and analyzed data.

docs.title: 經歷
docs.text:

大學部研究助理 國立清華大學，台灣

執行多項研究計畫，聚焦身體活動對特定族群腦功能之影響，以開發個人化運動處方。

  • 低強度阻力運動結合緩慢動作與靜態出力對老年人認知靈活性之影響（國科會計畫）：設計研究方法、執行標準化實驗（樣本數 n=45）並進行數據分析
  • 等量急性運動對中老年人後設認知之影響：執行實驗、進行數據分析，並撰寫期刊論文
  • 身體活動與聽障青少年執行功能之關係探討：設計研究方法、執行實驗並進行數據分析

即將升學之腦科學碩士班學生 · 陽明交通大學 | 運動科學系學士 · 清華大學

陽明交通大學教育研究所，腦科學組碩士班學生

我是陽明交通大學腦科學碩士班學生，運動科學系畢業，致力於結合運動神經科學與認知神經科學，透過腦影像研究大腦老化機制，以及運動對認知功能的保護作用。

信箱： scwang1005@gmail.com GitHub： github.com/chieh1005

docs.title: 研究方向
docs.text:
我的工作聚焦於臨床神經科學與人類運動的交界——利用腦影像技術探究神經退化疾病的機制。

  • 認知神經科學 — 注意力、記憶與執行功能在生命週期中的變化機制。
  • 神經影像 · fMRI 與 EEG — 建立 fMRI 與 EEG 分析流程，繪製大腦結構、功能與連結。
  • 運動、心理學與老化 — 探討身體活動是否能減緩認知衰退與神經退化。
